disclosure_reference.source: Annual Report 2025 p172; Investor Report H1 2026 p16; URLs recorded per input
disclosure_reference.note: Investor Report H1 2026 rounds the 2025 closing rate to 1.1756; Annual Report 2025 provides five decimal places. Q3 2026 not yet present on official publications page.

liquidity.cash_usd_m.label: DISCLOSED
liquidity.cash_usd_m.source: Investor Report H1 2026 pp14-15, 30 June 2026 USD cash; https://www.hapag-lloyd.com/content/dam/website/downloads/ir/HLAG_Investor_Report_H1_2026.pdf

liquidity.ocf_daily_usd_m.label: DERIVED
liquidity.ocf_daily_usd_m.formula: H1 2026 operating cash flow USD849m / 181 days

liquidity.historical_financing_adjustmen.label: MISSING
liquidity.historical_financing_adjustmen.source: Net historical financing/interest flows from balance_date to T0; excludes OCF/capex/leases

liquidity.lease_monthly_usd_m.label: DERIVED
liquidity.lease_monthly_usd_m.formula: FY2025 principal repayments (EUR1108.1m leases + EUR2.3m concessions) * 1.17565 USD/EUR / 12; D12 conversion convention
liquidity.lease_monthly_usd_m.rationale: Principal only; interest is a separate financing cash-flow line. Annual historical repayments used as the prospective run-rate assumption.

liquidity.capex_monthly_usd_m.label: DERIVED
liquidity.capex_monthly_usd_m.formula: H1 2026 cash capital expenditure USD255m / 6; excludes share acquisitions
liquidity.capex_monthly_usd_m.rationale: Historical cash capex run-rate, not future guidance.

liquidity.interest_in_ocf.label: DISCLOSED

liquidity.lease_includes_interest.label: DISCLOSED

freight.collection_lag_days.label: DERIVED
freight.collection_lag_days.formula: round(USD2998m trade receivables / (Q2 group revenue USD5840m / 91 days)) = round(46.7154)

freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q1.label: DISCLOSED
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q1.source: Investor Report Q1 2026 p2, 3203 TTEU, for Q1 2027 seasonality; https://www.hapag-lloyd.com/content/dam/website/downloads/ir/HLAG_Investor_Report_Q1_2026.pdf

freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q2.label: DISCLOSED
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q2.source: Investor Report H1 2026 pp2,10, 3481 TTEU Q2 2026, for Q2 2027 seasonality; https://www.hapag-lloyd.com/content/dam/website/downloads/ir/HLAG_Investor_Report_H1_2026.pdf

freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q3.label: PROXY
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q3.formula: Published Q3 2025 group transport volume 3425 TTEU * 1000; historical group seasonality times H1 2026 trade shares
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q3.rationale: 2025 group-volume fallback per specification 6.3; old finished-voyage measurement, not restated 2026-basis trade volumes. Reuse for Q3 2027 until Q3 2026 is published is a modelling assumption.

freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q4.label: PROXY
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q4.formula: (FY2025 group 13486 TTEU - 9M2025 group 10170 TTEU) * 1000 = 3316000 TEU; independently agrees with published Q4 group figure
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q4.source: Investor Report FY 2025 pp2,10 and Investor Report 9M 2025 p2; https://www.hapag-lloyd.com/content/dam/website/downloads/ir/HLAG_Investor_Report_FY_2025.pdf
freight.quarter_volume_teu.Q4.rationale: Prior-year group-volume seasonality fallback per specification 6.3; old finished-voyage measurement, not restated 2026-basis trade volumes. Reuse after Q4 2026 pending newer disclosure is a modelling assumption.

limitations: Synthetic exposure register; never the live company position.
Official Annual 2025 and H1 2026 financial reports verified on 2 November 2026; remaining unresolved items are explicit.

H1 2026 trade mapping verified. Quarterly group seasonality uses Q1/Q2 2026 and Q3/Q4 2025 disclosures times H1 2026 trade shares. Q3/Q4 retain the old measurement basis and are reused for later forecast months until newer figures are published; this is an explicit approximation.
Freight all-in base rate overstates ex-fuel freight sensitivity by about 15%.
No forward points, trapped cash, entity-level cash, ETS costs or execution.
Cash projection is daily through day 91 and monthly thereafter; later minima are accurate only to the month.
